line.en: A concept map set in type on a cool layout sheet: each term on its own underline, which runs on as the line to the next, drawn to say the relation.

for.en: Explainers about how things relate: cycles and processes, chains of causes, root-cause reviews, how the parts of a system relate, decisions and their side effects.

not.en: Stories told through people and places, mood pieces, and films carried by photographs.
